title: Use product-to-sum
text: Use $$sin\left(x\right) sin\left(3x\right)=\frac{1}{2} \left(cos\left(2x\right)-cos\left(4x\right)\right)$$, then multiply by $$sin\left(2x\right)$$ and use product-to-sum again.

title: Evaluate
text: The integrand becomes a sum of multiples of $$sin\left(2x\right)$$, $$sin\left(4x\right)$$ and $$sin\left(6x\right)$$. Each of these integrates to $$0$$ from $$0$$ to $$2\pi$$.
